Monetary value tracking across orders and their line items is supported by these schema fields.

At the order line-item level (`ORDER_LINE_ITEM` / OrderLineItem), the monetary fields are `UNIT_PRICE` (DECIMAL(10,2), “Price at time of order”, Nullable = NO) and `LINE_AMT` (DECIMAL(12,2), “Extended amount (qty × price)”, Nullable = NO). The line’s extended amount is explicitly defined as `LINE_AMT = QUANTITY × UNIT_PRICE`, supported by the schema field `QUANTITY` (INT, “Number of units”, Nullable = NO). Each line item ties back to its order via `ORDER_ID` (BIGINT, Nullable = NO).

At the order-payment level (`PAYMENT`), the monetary amount applied to an order is stored in `AMOUNT` (DECIMAL(12,2), “Payment amount”, Nullable = NO), linked to the order via `ORDER_ID` (BIGINT, Nullable = NO) with `PAYMENT.ORDER_ID → SALES_ORDER_HDR(ORDER_ID)`.
